summary: Move one file or directory path.

input_schema.source_path: string | The full path of the file or directory to move.
input_schema.target_path: string | The new full path for the file or directory.
input_schema.if_revision: string | optional | Only move if the source's current revision matches this value.
input_schema.force: boolean | optional | Force the move, overwriting the target if it exists. Defaults to false.

output_schema.path: string | The full path of the moved entry.
output_schema.name: string | The name of the moved entry.
output_schema.entry_type: string | The type of the entry ('directory' or 'file').
output_schema.size_bytes: integer | The size of the entry in bytes.
output_schema.created_at: date-time|null|optional | The timestamp when the entry was created.
output_schema.updated_at: date-time|null|optional | The timestamp when the entry was last updated.
output_schema.revision: string | The revision identifier for the entry.
